M9Y.error: PermissionError WinError 5 while replacing shared goldsharp_m1.csv journal, followed by PermissionError while rollback attempted to replace the same shared journal path

root_cause.detail: All seven processes used a serialized adapter lock for writers, but strategy cycles read the same shared journal paths after the writer lock was released. On Windows, another process holding goldsharp_m1.csv open for reading could prevent os.replace of that shared path during a later adapter append and could also prevent rollback replacement.
root_cause.why_only_M9Y_stopped_in_package: M9Y encountered the first observed collision after three successful cycles. The other six were healthy at the audit instant but remained exposed to the same shared-path race.

V4_correction.snapshot_locking: Snapshot copies are materialized while holding the existing adapter update lock.
V4_correction.snapshot_verification: Every copied timeframe file must match current verified shared-journal size and SHA256.
V4_correction.M9V_bootstrap: Existing immutable runtime state_at_start remains authoritative.
V4_correction.transient_windows_IO: PermissionError and WinError 5/32/33 are converted to AdapterTransientError so a temporary collision waits rather than resets or reinitializes.

upgrade_operator.behavior: Requests normal STOP-file shutdown, waits for all seven process markers and locks to disappear, and does not kill processes or delete locks.
